_comment: Single source of truth for the left-tree GLB geometry. Edited by hand, consumed by blender/build_left_tree.py. After editing, run: python3 blender/build_left_tree.py

_branch_field_docs.name: Human-readable label. Not used by the mesh, just for reading the config.
_branch_field_docs.t: Height along the trunk, 0.0 = base, 1.0 = top of trunk (trunk.height above origin).
_branch_field_docs.side: +1 = branch points to +X (rightward on the page), -1 = -X (leftward).
_branch_field_docs.tilt_deg: Angle above horizontal. 0 = horizontal, 90 = straight up. Slightly negative allowed (points down).
_branch_field_docs.length: Branch length in world units. Trunk diameter is ~0.24 for scale — stubs should be short (0.10-0.35).
_branch_field_docs.r_base_frac: Currently ignored — base ring is determined by the 3x3 trunk patch.
_branch_field_docs.segments: Number of ring cross-sections along the branch (more = smoother taper).
_branch_field_docs.radial: Ignored — forced to 8 to match the 3x3 patch boundary count.
_branch_field_docs.droop: Parabolic gravitational sag: -droop * t^2 at the tip. 0 = perfectly straight.
_branch_field_docs.twist_deg: Small azimuthal offset so the branch isn't perfectly axis-aligned.

_design_note: Matching public/fauna/left_tree.png — the tree is a tall thin trunk with SHORT stubby branches (broken-twig style). Branch lengths should stay small (0.10-0.35 world units) so the tree silhouette stays inside the PNG column. The raccoon branch is a slightly larger stub as a visual marker for the Projects section — the raccoon scene itself lives elsewhere.

branches.name: raccoons_projects_section
branches._comment: Visual marker for the Projects (raccoons) section. Slightly bigger stub. The actual raccoon scene lives in ProjectorRaccoonScene.
